product_overview: Soy-Dee is a mobile-first health tracking web app that lets members record daily food, activity, and sleep data, then review health summaries such as BMI, BMR, and TDEE on a dashboard. Admin users manage food categories, activity types, and view system reports through a separate admin panel.
core_goals: Register as a new member and sign in by role
Track daily food intake, physical activity, and sleep records
Review personal health summaries and history on a dashboard
Update profile information, body stats, avatar, and password
Manage admin content for food categories and activity types
View admin system overview, reports, and member information

features.name: Welcome/Splash Redirect
features.description: A landing screen that automatically routes unauthenticated visitors toward the login experience.
user_flows: Navigate to /views/auth/welcome.html -> See the splash screen -> Get redirected to /views/auth/login.html

features.name: Member/Admin Login
features.description: A role-based login flow for members and admins with client-side validation and session creation.
user_flows: Navigate to /views/auth/login.html -> Choose the member role -> Enter username or email -> Enter password -> Submit the form -> See the member dashboard
Navigate to /views/auth/login.html -> Choose the admin role -> Enter username or email -> Enter password -> Submit the form -> See the admin panel
Navigate to /views/auth/login.html -> Enter a password that is too short -> Submit the form -> See an inline validation error
Navigate to /views/auth/login.html -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the form -> See an inline authentication error

features.name: Member Registration
features.description: A new account creation flow for members that captures profile and body-stat details and signs the user in automatically after successful registration.
user_flows: Navigate to /views/auth/register.html -> Enter account details and body-stat information -> Submit the registration form -> Get signed in automatically -> See the member dashboard

features.name: Member Dashboard
features.description: A personalized dashboard where signed-in members review their health summary, latest body stats, and BMR history, and move to record-entry pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /views/user/index.html -> View profile information -> Review health summary cards -> Review recent BMR history -> Go to food, activity, or sleep records

features.name: Food Record Management
features.description: A daily food logging area where members add, edit, and delete food records for a chosen date using available food categories.
user_flows: Navigate to /views/user/food-record.html -> Pick a date -> Add a food record with category and amount -> Save the entry -> See it appear in the daily list
Navigate to /views/user/food-record.html -> Pick a date -> Select an existing food record -> Change the details -> Save the updates -> See the updated entry in the list
Navigate to /views/user/food-record.html -> Pick a date -> Select an existing food record -> Delete the entry -> See it removed from the list

features.name: Activity Record Management
features.description: A daily activity logging area where members add, edit, and delete physical activity records for a chosen date.
user_flows: Navigate to /views/user/activity-record.html -> Pick a date -> Add an activity record with activity type and duration -> Save the entry -> See it appear in the daily list
Navigate to /views/user/activity-record.html -> Pick a date -> Select an existing activity record -> Change the details -> Save the updates -> See the updated entry in the list
Navigate to /views/user/activity-record.html -> Pick a date -> Select an existing activity record -> Delete the entry -> See it removed from the list

features.name: Sleep Record & Evaluation
features.description: A sleep tracking area where members log sleep timing for a chosen date and view a computed sleep-quality evaluation.
user_flows: Navigate to /views/user/sleep-record.html -> Pick a date -> Add a sleep record with sleep time and wake time -> Save the entry -> View the sleep evaluation result
Navigate to /views/user/sleep-record.html -> Pick a date -> Select an existing sleep record -> Change the sleep times -> Save the updates -> View the updated sleep evaluation result
Navigate to /views/user/sleep-record.html -> Pick a date -> Select an existing sleep record -> Delete the entry -> See it removed from the list

features.name: Member Profile & Body Stats
features.description: A profile area where members edit personal information, update body stats, upload an avatar, change their password, and log out.
user_flows: Navigate to /views/user/profile.html -> Review current profile details -> Edit profile information -> Save the changes -> See the updated profile
Navigate to /views/user/profile.html -> Review current body stats -> Edit weight, height, or activity level -> Save the changes -> See updated body stats and recalculated BMR
Navigate to /views/user/profile.html -> Upload a new avatar image -> See the profile picture update
Navigate to /views/user/profile.html -> Change the password -> Save the new password -> Stay signed in with the updated credentials
Navigate to /views/user/profile.html -> Start logout -> Confirm logout -> Get redirected to /views/auth/login.html

features.name: Admin - Food Category Management
features.description: An admin CRUD workspace for managing food categories with search and pagination.
user_flows: Navigate to /views/admin/admin.html -> Switch to the food categories section -> Search by name -> Browse paginated results -> Add a new food category -> See it in the list
Navigate to /views/admin/admin.html -> Switch to the food categories section -> Search by name -> Browse paginated results -> Select a food category -> Edit it -> See the updated category in the list
Navigate to /views/admin/admin.html -> Switch to the food categories section -> Select a food category -> Delete it -> See it removed from the list

features.name: Admin - Activity Type Management
features.description: An admin CRUD workspace for managing activity types with search and pagination.
user_flows: Navigate to /views/admin/admin.html -> Switch to the activity types section -> Search by name -> Browse paginated results -> Add a new activity type -> See it in the list
Navigate to /views/admin/admin.html -> Switch to the activity types section -> Search by name -> Browse paginated results -> Select an activity type -> Edit it -> See the updated type in the list
Navigate to /views/admin/admin.html -> Switch to the activity types section -> Select an activity type -> Delete it -> See it removed from the list

features.name: Admin - Member List (read-only)
features.description: A read-only admin view for browsing members and opening a selected member's detail view.
user_flows: Navigate to /views/admin/admin.html -> Switch to the member information section -> Search members -> Browse paginated results -> Open a member detail view -> Review the member information

features.name: Admin - Reports
features.description: An admin reporting area for filtering and viewing aggregate results.
user_flows: Navigate to /views/admin/admin.html -> Switch to the reports section -> Apply report filters -> View the filtered report results

features.name: Admin - System Overview
features.description: A default admin overview showing system-wide summary statistics.
user_flows: Navigate to /views/admin/admin.html -> Arrive at the system overview -> Review the system-wide statistic cards

features.name: Logout
features.description: A session-ending flow that clears the current session and returns the user to the login page.
user_flows: Start logout from an authenticated session -> Confirm logout -> Get redirected to /views/auth/login.html

tech_stack: Vanilla JavaScript (ES6, IIFE modules, no bundler)
Fetch API (window.SoyDeeAPI client, JWT stored in localStorage)
REST backend at http://localhost:8080/api/v1 (separate Go API project)

Member registration (multi-step form incl. body stats)

known_limitations.issue: Previous TestSprite runs used member credentials (soydee_test01/Soydee123) for admin-login tests, since the test config only carries one shared credential pair. No admin account with that username existed, causing every admin-login test to fail and eventually trip backend rate limiting.
known_limitations.impact: Fixed by creating a dedicated admin account (sys_username=soydee_test01, matching password) in the soydee DB. Admin login now verified working directly against the backend (POST /auth/login/admin returns 200). Admin-panel test coverage (sidebar nav, CRUD, reports) should now be reachable.

known_limitations.issue: Backend is a separate Go API project not present in this repository (only reachable at http://localhost:8080/api/v1)
known_limitations.impact: All API-calling features require the backend server to be running locally for tests to pass; failures may be backend-side rather than frontend bugs

known_limitations.issue: Admin panel (admin.html/admin.js/admin.css) was substantially reworked (new sidebar nav, table headers, pagination) and is currently uncommitted
